<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/result"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the results of the caller's organization, newest first. Filter by `run`, `goal_index` or `evaluation_status`, and leave the traces out with `include_traces=false` for a lighter response. Paginated with `page` and `page_size` (default 10, at most 1000). Staff users see every organization's results.
